title: Students at Guatemala City School Allegedly Created and Shared AI-Generated Nude Images of Female Classmates
summary: At Colegio Continental Americano, a private school in Guatemala City, students allegedly used classmates' social-media photos to create and circulate purportedly AI-altered nude images. Families filed complaints, and authorities investigated. A juvenile court subsequently opened proceedings against four former students over alleged sexual-privacy violations and offenses involving sexual images of minors. The AI software has not been identified.
